limitations: NPC IDs/count are recorded, but NPC positions, activity states and common simulation epoch are not; exact NPC-pose equality cannot be proven.
MEMORY_STATIC is Godot static allocation, not process RSS; peak RSS was not recorded.
All six saved windows have inactive smoke; these pairs do not establish active-smoke, punctured-tyre, critical-engine or sustained bullet-hit full-scene cost.
Moving candidate finishes with one native-collision damage event and engine HP 97.620891, so it is not literally a damage-free workload. No intentional bullet/smoke workload is accepted here.
Each native trajectory remains dynamic and differs slightly; recorded end positions are retained rather than called exact.
Startup/boarding/acceleration-to-3mps and PCM/cache construction are excluded from the five-second sample.
Fixed extra benchmark camera, frozen visual day clock and disabled player/game unhandled input bound applicability; NPC and physics remain active.

TIME_PROCESS and TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS are cached engine monitors; authoritative frame cost here is wall interval between frame_post_draw signals. Do not subtract independent maxima or sum cached monitors as frame cost.
Per-frame candidate dust/audio diagnostics add unseparated QA overhead; this is not a pure subsystem timing.
Same editor identity does not itself certify identical editor activity; no overlap was detected by recorded periodic perf audits.
